goal: Baseline audit plus sandbox and application-control safety before any intelligence work.

items.instr: Document the existing job-agent architecture, data flow, scoring, application flow, learning flow and safety boundaries against runtime/code. Produce a baseline document and verify it is consistent with the live code and DB.
items.doneWhen: Existing job-agent architecture, data flow, scoring, application flow, learning flow and safety boundaries are documented and verified against runtime/code.

items.instr: Prove SANDBOX=true is unable to produce a real external application/email through every submission path, with integration tests covering the final submission boundary.
items.doneWhen: SANDBOX=true is proven unable to produce a real external application/email through every submission path, with integration tests covering the final submission boundary.

items.instr: Add passing regression tests covering the existing kill switch, caps, deduplication, approval gate, mailbox controls and existing application paths.
items.doneWhen: Existing kill switch, caps, deduplication, approval gate, mailbox controls and existing application paths have passing regression tests.

goal: Replace ad-hoc match scoring with a single qualification engine and hard eligibility checks.

items.instr: Create a single qualification service that evaluates leads before application preparation and exposes a structured qualification result.
items.doneWhen: A single qualification service evaluates leads before application preparation and exposes a structured qualification result.

items.instr: Extract and evaluate mandatory requirements separately from general similarity, and allow hard failures to prevent application.
items.doneWhen: Mandatory requirements are extracted and evaluated separately from general similarity, and hard failures can prevent application.

items.instr: Convert job descriptions into structured role intent including role family, seniority, technologies, responsibilities, location, work mode and other relevant constraints.
items.doneWhen: Job descriptions are converted into structured role intent including role family, seniority, technologies, responsibilities, location, work mode and other relevant constraints.

items.instr: Link important JD requirements to verified candidate evidence with evidence strength and confidence.
items.doneWhen: Important JD requirements can be linked to verified candidate evidence with evidence strength and confidence.

items.instr: Recognize legitimate equivalent terminology while rejecting materially different technologies, with tests for false positives.
items.doneWhen: Semantic matching recognizes legitimate equivalent terminology while rejecting materially different technologies, with tests for false positives.

items.instr: Classify missing requirements into meaningful severity/transferability categories and let them influence qualification.
items.doneWhen: Missing requirements are classified into meaningful severity/transferability categories and influence qualification.

goal: Add career-fit, job-quality and ROI scoring plus explainable decisions.

items.instr: Evaluate whether a job represents an appropriate career progression, independently from technical match.
items.doneWhen: The system evaluates whether a job represents an appropriate career progression, independently from technical match.

items.instr: Let job freshness, validity, duplicate/staleness signals and source/employer quality affect prioritization.
items.doneWhen: Job freshness, validity, duplicate/staleness signals and source/employer quality affect prioritization.

items.instr: Evaluate whether a job is worth spending an application opportunity on using transparent scoring components.
items.doneWhen: The system evaluates whether a job is worth spending an application opportunity on using transparent scoring components.

items.instr: Persist reasons, strengths, gaps, evidence and confidence for every APPLY / HUMAN_REVIEW / WATCH / DO_NOT_APPLY decision.
items.doneWhen: Every APPLY / HUMAN_REVIEW / WATCH / DO_NOT_APPLY decision has persisted reasons, strengths, gaps, evidence and confidence.

items.instr: Allow strong transferable experience to prevent an otherwise premature rejection and route suitable near-miss jobs to HUMAN_REVIEW.
items.doneWhen: Strong transferable experience can prevent an otherwise premature rejection and route suitable near-miss jobs to HUMAN_REVIEW.

goal: Ground CV generation in a verified evidence library and add drift protection.

items.instr: Base tailoring on a canonical, verified candidate evidence set and prevent inventing experience.
items.doneWhen: Tailoring is based on a canonical, verified candidate evidence set and cannot invent experience.

items.instr: Choose an appropriate CV strategy/profile for the job before generating the tailored CV.
items.doneWhen: The system chooses an appropriate CV strategy/profile for the job before generating the tailored CV.

items.instr: Make tailored CV generation demonstrably constrained to verified candidate evidence.
items.doneWhen: Tailored CV generation is demonstrably constrained to verified candidate evidence.

items.instr: Check generated CV content for excessive semantic drift and flag unsafe rewrites.
items.doneWhen: Generated CV content is checked for excessive semantic drift and unsafe rewrites are flagged.

items.instr: Measure ATS compatibility and human-readable recruiter quality separately.
items.doneWhen: ATS compatibility and human-readable recruiter quality are measured separately.

goal: Make channel selection, ATS handling and deduplication smarter and learnable.

items.instr: Let historical channel performance influence selection among valid channels without overriding employer-stated instructions.
items.doneWhen: Historical channel performance can influence selection among valid channels without overriding employer-stated instructions.

items.instr: Capture, normalize and surface unknown required ATS questions to the answer bank for user completion.
items.doneWhen: Unknown required ATS questions are captured, normalized and surfaced to the answer bank for user completion.

items.instr: Store and reuse verified successful field mappings for subsequent applications.
items.doneWhen: Verified successful field mappings are stored and reused for subsequent applications.

items.instr: Recognize cross-portal duplicates/reposts and prevent them from generating duplicate applications.
items.doneWhen: Cross-portal duplicates/reposts can be recognized and prevented from generating duplicate applications.

goal: Add employer-level, recruiter-relationship and outcome-driven learning.

items.instr: Provide employer-level application/reply/interview outcome statistics with minimum-sample safeguards.
items.doneWhen: Employer-level application/reply/interview outcome statistics are available with minimum-sample safeguards.

items.instr: Let verified recruiter/application relationships influence future prioritization without causing spam.
items.doneWhen: Verified recruiter/application relationships can influence future prioritization without causing spam.

items.instr: Let rejection and no-response outcomes contribute structured features to future job qualification.
items.doneWhen: Rejection and no-response outcomes contribute structured features to future job qualification.

items.instr: Feed interview and offer outcomes into future role/company/channel/CV prioritization.
items.doneWhen: Interview and offer outcomes feed future role/company/channel/CV prioritization.

items.instr: Make learning decisions account for sample size and confidence and avoid overfitting small datasets.
items.doneWhen: Learning decisions account for sample size and confidence and do not overfit small datasets.

goal: Track and learn from template and CV strategy variants.

items.instr: Persistently identify email/cover-letter template variants.
items.doneWhen: Email/cover-letter template variants are persistently identified.

items.instr: Correlate template performance with reply/interview outcomes using sufficient sample sizes.
items.doneWhen: Template performance can be correlated with reply/interview outcomes using sufficient sample sizes.

items.instr: Correlate CV strategy variants with application outcomes.
items.doneWhen: CV strategy variants can be correlated with application outcomes.

goal: Manage job lifecycle, portal status and follow-ups.

items.instr: Let jobs transition through active, qualified, applied, closed/expired and other required lifecycle states without generating stale applications.
items.doneWhen: Jobs can transition through active, qualified, applied, closed/expired and other required lifecycle states without stale applications being generated.

items.instr: Incorporate available portal/employer status information where technically and legally appropriate.
items.doneWhen: Available portal/employer status information is incorporated where technically and legally appropriate.

items.instr: Schedule follow-ups according to configurable policy, duplicate-safe and subject to approval/autonomy controls.
items.doneWhen: Follow-ups can be scheduled according to configurable policy, duplicate-safe and subject to approval/autonomy controls.

goal: Improve the pre-apply queue, explanations and digest.

items.instr: Prioritize jobs in /pre-apply-page using qualification/ROI rather than raw matchScore alone and expose the important decision factors.
items.doneWhen: /pre-apply-page prioritizes jobs using qualification/ROI rather than raw matchScore alone and exposes the important decision factors.

items.instr: Let the user understand why a job was recommended, rejected or sent for review without inspecting raw JSON.
items.doneWhen: The user can understand why a job was recommended, rejected or sent for review without inspecting raw JSON.

items.instr: Include high-priority opportunities, outcomes and meaningful learning signals in the daily digest.
items.doneWhen: Daily digest includes high-priority opportunities, outcomes and meaningful learning signals.

goal: Close the loop from outcomes back into job ranking, with safety boundaries and KPI measurement.

items.instr: Make application outcomes demonstrably feed future job ranking/qualification.
items.doneWhen: Application outcomes demonstrably feed future job ranking/qualification.

items.instr: Allow learning to modify ranking/preferences but prevent it from automatically modifying hard safety, truthfulness, authorization, sandbox or user-policy rules.
items.doneWhen: Learning can modify ranking/preferences but cannot automatically modify hard safety, truthfulness, authorization, sandbox or user-policy rules.

items.instr: Measure at least: qualified jobs, applications, reply rate, interview rate, offer rate, rejection rate, no-response rate, qualification precision, false-positive applications, false-negative samples where identified, channel performance, CV strategy performance.
items.doneWhen: The system measures at least: qualified jobs, applications, reply rate, interview rate, offer rate, rejection rate, no-response rate, qualification precision, false-positive applications, false-negative samples where identified, channel performance, CV strategy performance.
